title: Meet Your New On-Call Peer: AI-Powered EKS Troubleshooting with AWS DevOps Agent
abstract: When production breaks, standard monitoring isn't enough. SREs waste critical time untangling metrics and IAM policies, while developers struggle to isolate application code issues from infrastructure limits. Join us to discover how the AWS DevOps Agent bridges this gap by shifting from reactive monitoring to autonomous troubleshooting. We will demonstrate real-world scenarios from EKS failures to application layer bottlenecks and show how the agent correlates siloed telemetry data to instantly surface root causes. Learn how to leverage autonomous remediations to slash your MTTR and elevate your team's incident response.

title: Agents, The Superhuman Layer for Your Telemetry
abstract: Microservices or AI distributed systems, they all break, they have the same challenges with ensuring performance and reliability. However, the role of AI in observability has fundamentally evolved. We have transitioned from basic telemetry scraping and passive querying to autonomous AI agents capable of predicting downtimes, executing root-cause analysis (RCA), recommending code refactors, and driving automated remediation. In this session we will understand how the evolution has impacted observability space along with extended MCP and integrations that can help you with faster MTTR.

title: Alerts Quality Management Workshop
abstract: Step into the shoes of a newly hired Site Reliability Engineer tasked with a critical mission: using guided missiles to protect spaceships from asteroids. In this hands-on workshop, you will master New Relic Alerts to survive the chaos. We will dive into Alert Quality Management, explore strategies to prevent alert fatigue and "alert storms," and leverage metrics, events, logs, and traces for superior signal acquisition. You will also get a foundational introduction to Observability as Code, equipping you with the vital skills needed to keep humanity's space travels safe.
